en: Colorized historic postcard showing a tall bronze statue of a robed clergyman (Mgr. Hamer) on a large stone pedestal in a landscaped park or square. The base is decorated with many wreaths and floral arrangements, and a few people stand nearby. Trees and some buildings are visible in the background, under a clear blue sky. The top-left corner bears printed red text indicating the location and subject of the monument.
